items.html: However, the coronet of Gevura, together with the brain of Bina of ZA, which is in the left strap, is not hidden at the chest, but is drawn outside in the secret of surrounding light, also for the female, until the navel of ZA; for there begins the NHY of ZA, and it enters there, so that those Mochin may be clothed there within the NHY of ZA, to be Mochin for his Nukva, in the manner of the Mochin of ZA that were clothed in the NHY of Ima, as above. And since ZA took for himself most of the coronet of Hesed, he did not need to take from the coronet of Gevura more than a small matter, and all of it or most of it remained for his Nukva, as mentioned.
